description: CARTESIAN-TO-CARTESIAN conservative regridding END-TO-END DECLARATIVE with BOTH grids constructed in-library -- the ESD-side close of the cartesian<->cartesian regridding gap. regridding/cartesian_cell_rings.esm is imported TWICE under esm-spec 9.7.7 namespace prefixes (prefix `src` at GX=GY=3 for the 3x3 unit-cell source over [0,3]^2; prefix `tgt` at GX=GY=2 for the 2x2 target of 1.5-degree cells over the same [0,3]^2). Renaming is transitive through the ring_* index sets (src.ring_cells / tgt.ring_cells), the GX*GY size fold, and the match-less templates -- applied by their DOTTED names src.cartesian_cell_rings_poly / tgt.cartesian_cell_rings_poly with their {from: ring_cells} body references renamed to each edge's own axis. Both constructed ring stacks feed ONE conservative_overlap import (NSRC=9, NTGT=4, NVERT=4) at manifold 'planar', so grid-spec -> rings -> regrid runs with no out-of-document precomputation on either side (the sibling cartesian_rings_regrid_3x3_to_2x2 still supplied source rings as const data because one document then supported only one ring import; here both sides are constructed). Gates: (1) affine_formula -- both constructed ring stacks match their inline hand oracles EXACTLY (abs 0.0); (2) exact_invariants -- partition-of-unity and conservation per CONFORMANCE_SPEC 5.8.3 (the constructed target tiles the constructed source); (3) the golden per-pair weights (official Julia runner via scripts/regenerate-goldens.sh) -- because the constructed geometry equals conservative_overlap_3x3_to_2x2's hand-authored geometry ring for ring, the golden reproduces the same exact rationals (A_ij corner 1.0 / edge 0.5 / center 0.25 deg^2, A_j = 2.25, W = 4/9 / 2/9 / 1/9, F_tgt = [7/3, 11/3, 19/3, 23/3], mass 45). Requires no ESS change: the §9.7.7 renaming ported in the 2026-07 wave already reaches explicitly-applied library templates and their renamed index-set references (probed against the Julia reference before authoring).

scope_excluded.go: rewrite-only port; no aggregate lowering / simulator
scope_excluded.typescript: rewrite-only port; no aggregate lowering / simulator

tolerances._doc: Identical to conservative_overlap_3x3_to_2x2 (same geometry after construction, same 5.8 contract). The affine-formula geometry gate is in-fixture at abs 0.0.
